statement: Build a one-page website for Brew Lab, a specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with a menu with prices, opening hours, location, a pre-order for pickup, a section about its beans and farms, and a loyalty card explainer (buy 9, get the 10th free).
audience: Coffee drinkers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru who want to see the menu, find the shop, pre-order a coffee for pickup and learn about the loyalty card.
standards: One HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript; CDN libraries allowed; no build step; no server code
Plain English copy, readable on phone and desktop
No invented prices, hours, address, farm names, bean origins or phone numbers; every unknown fact is shown as a visible TBC tag
rules: Pre-order reaches the shop as a prefilled WhatsApp message to the shop's number; the page has no backend and stores no customer data
The page states that a pre-order is a request until staff confirm on WhatsApp
Payment is at pickup only; the page collects no online payment
The customer chooses a pickup time slot at order time, labelled as a request, not a promised ready time
Facts only the Requester can supply are shown as marked TBC placeholders and tracked in open_inputs; they do not block done
done_when: The site is a single HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inline, needing no build step and no server code
The file has one page with a menu section listing drinks, each with a price in rupees or a visible TBC tag
The file has an opening hours section covering every day of the week, with each unknown time shown as a visible TBC tag
The file has a location section naming Indiranagar, Bengaluru, with the street address and map pin shown as visible TBC tags until supplied
The file has a pre-order section where a customer picks items and quantities, enters a name and chooses a pickup slot, and a button opens a WhatsApp link with the order text prefilled
The pre-order section states that payment is at pickup and that the order is a request until staff confirm on WhatsApp, and the file contains no payment or card-entry form
The WhatsApp number in the pre-order link is a visible TBC placeholder, not an invented number
The file has a beans and farms section in which every bean origin and farm name is a visible TBC tag and no unsupplied sourcing claim appears
The file has a loyalty card section stating buy 9 coffees, get the 10th free
Every price, hour, address, map pin, bean origin, farm name and phone number in the file is either marked with a visible TBC tag or removed; none is invented
open_inputs: Menu items and the price of each
Pickup slot times and the number of orders the shop can take per slot
Bean origins and farm names for the beans and farms section
Loyalty card details beyond buy 9, get the 10th free, such as which items count
